resources.string: Hold the watch button and speak. What you say is written into the calendar event that\'s running, or into a new event when nothing is. Speech is recognised on this phone: nothing goes to the internet.

1. Settings → Developer options: turn on \"Experimental settings\".\n2. Your watch → Device settings → Experimental settings: turn on \"Assistant service\", then reconnect the watch.\n3. Device settings → Developer settings → Voice Assistant: enter the two values below.

A note goes to the event that was running when you started speaking. All-day events and declined ones don\'t count. During an invitation you can\'t edit, the note goes to a new \"Notes: …\" event over the same time.
Look for the running event in
With nothing running, a note becomes a 15-minute \"Voice note\" event; notes in the next 15 minutes join it.
No calendar you can write to. Add an account to the phone, or allow calendar access.
The running event\'s title is given to Whisper as context, so its names and words come out right.
